messages:
incident-bot: Pager P1 — metering anomaly detected in prod-us-west-2. metric=token_count_delta > 10% over 10m for service=emitter-proxy. Runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/metering-anomaly. Paging @oncall-alex and oncall rotation.

oncall-alex: ack — I'm on it, looking at dashboards now.

sre_lead_maya: @oncall-alex any customer-facing errors or 5xx spikes? quick status?

oncall-alex: quick look: token_count spike ~+12% vs expected over last 10m. API 2xx fine, no bulk 5xx. CS reports a few customers got overage notification emails at ~03:24. Dashboard: https://metrics/redwood/metering/token_delta?range=15m

billing-eng-ravi: I see the same signal in emitter logs. Suspect duplicate emits introduced by emitter-proxy v2 (rolled ~03:10). Starting rollback to v1 now: `kubectl -n metering rollout undo deployment/emitter-proxy --to-revision=3`

oncall-alex: rollback initiated, ETA ~4m. Meanwhile running a reconcile dry-run: `python tools/reconcile_counts.py --window=15m --dry-run --out=tmp/recon-03-24.json` to estimate false flags.

cs_emma: received 2 support tickets from AcmeCorp and RedMall — both got an overage email referencing a large spike at 03:24. They're asking if charges will stick. Drafting interim note.

product-jordan: can we pause customer overage notifications (not billing ingestion) until we confirm? We should avoid spooking more customers.

billing-eng-ravi: can do. Pausing notify job: `svc pause job billing-notify` — paused. Confirmed no new overage emails will go out. Ledger collection continues; we will not post charges until reconcile/qa. Also kicked off a dedupe replay: `replay-dedupe --source=emitter-proxy --since=03:00 --until=03:40`

oncall-alex: rollback complete — emitter-proxy metrics normalized within 2m of rollback. Dry-run reconcile suggests ~92% of the extra tokens were duplicates; live reconcile started.

incident-bot: Alert update — escalation threshold cleared. Pager will auto-close if no new anomalies in 15m. Please remember to follow the post-incident checklist.

cs_emma: I sent an interim message to affected customers: short apology + note that notifications were paused and we will not finalize charges until a full reconciliation. Template used: "We're investigating a billing notification error; notifications are paused and we're verifying usage — no charges will post until we confirm."

sre_lead_maya: action items: 1) Add emitter duplication healthcheck (watch for duplicate event IDs) before deploy gating. 2) Add a pre-deploy canary that compares emitted token delta vs traffic. Assign to @billing-eng-ravi. Also schedule postmortem doc.

billing-eng-ravi: ack — will add healthcheck and a dedupe step to the emitter pipeline. Creating tracking ticket ENG-3412 and will link postmortem.

product-jordan: thanks team — please add a short summary for PMs with customer list and timelines once reconcile finishes.

oncall-alex: updating timeline in incident tracker and closing pager in 10m if metrics stay stable. Closing note will include affected accounts, rollback timestamp, reconcile result file.

incident-bot: Reminder: run `tools/postincident/validate_billing.sh` and attach outputs to the incident doc.

cs_emma: will follow up with customers after recon complete.

sre_lead_maya: good work — low-severity customer impact confirmed because we paused notifications before charges finalized. Postmortem + action items due EOD tomorrow.

oncall-alex: closing thread once postmortem ticket created and reconcile confirms no billed overages. Thanks all.
